rubric.instructions:
You are reviewing anonymous public-safe rendered research-slide pages for admission into a production gold scientific composition library. Inspect the actual pixels of every item before judging. Do not infer quality from order, file names, metadata, SHA values, or presumed provenance.
For each anonymous item, decide whether its visible composition reaches a mature doctoral research-group meeting or strong conference-talk bar for reuse as a composition reference. PASS means the page has a clear scientific object, mature hierarchy, projection-readable typography, disciplined whitespace, useful annotation/caption/legend/panel relationships, and does not read as an unfinished template, fixture, or internal QA artifact. REVISE means the pixels are useful only as ordinary inspected reference or comparative background, not production gold. BLOCKED means the pixels cannot be assessed.
Assess each item independently. Explicitly mention the primary scientific object, visual maturity, scientific-object prominence, page-job fit, typography/projection readability, and why it should be admitted or rejected. It is valid for multiple items to fail; do not admit weak pages for coverage.
Top-level decision is about whether this evidence packet is assessable. Put item quality decisions in item_reviews. Return top-level PASS when the packet is assessable even if some items are rejected.
